heading: Pages
description: Review each page using the best stored search evidence available for this site. Nothing is collected until you choose Refresh.

actions.openPage: Open page in a new tab

gsc.label: Google Search Console
gsc.description: Observed clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position from the selected rolling window.

dataforseo.label: Fallback ranking snapshot
dataforseo.description: A point-in-time ranked-keyword snapshot. Clicks, impressions, and CTR are not available from this source.

demo.label: Demo ranking snapshot
demo.description: Deterministic sample ranking data. It is not Google Search Console data or live DataForSEO data.

none.label: No stored source
none.description: No Search Console page data or fallback ranking snapshot has been stored yet.

states.backgroundLoading: Updating this view while keeping the previous data visible.

ready.title: Page data is ready
ready.gsc: Stored Search Console page data is ready.
ready.dataforseo: The stored fallback ranking snapshot is ready.
ready.demo: The stored demo ranking snapshot is ready.

syncing.title: Search Console is syncing
syncing.gsc: The first Search Console page collection is still pending or running. Fallback data is not substituted while GSC is authoritative.
syncing.dataforseo: Fallback ranking data is being prepared.
syncing.demo: Demo ranking data is being prepared.
syncing.none: A stored source is being prepared.

empty.title: No matching pages
empty.gsc: Search Console returned no page rows for this selected rolling window.
empty.dataforseo: The fallback snapshot found no ranking pages for this market.
empty.demo: The demo snapshot contains no ranking pages for this context.
empty.none: Connect Search Console or explicitly collect a metered fallback snapshot.

unavailable.title: Page data is unavailable
unavailable.gsc: Authoritative Search Console data is currently unavailable. Retry without switching to fallback data.
unavailable.dataforseo: The ranking provider could not produce a stored snapshot. Retry when the provider is available.
unavailable.demo: Demo ranking data could not be loaded.
unavailable.none: No usable stored source is available. Use the connection guidance or collect fallback data explicitly.

stale.title: Showing the last good data
stale.gsc: Search Console freshness is uncertain or its latest refresh failed. The last successful rows remain visible.
stale.dataforseo: This ranking snapshot is older than the fallback cache freshness window or its latest refresh failed.
stale.demo: This demo snapshot is stale. The last successful rows remain visible.
stale.none: The last stored state is stale.

transport.title: Pages could not be loaded
transport.body: The request did not complete. Check the connection and try again.
transport.retained: The update failed, so the previous page data remains visible.

notFound.title: Site or page data was not found

refreshFailed.title: Refresh failed
refreshFailed.body: The last good data remains visible. Try the explicit refresh again when the source is available.

cap.title: Fallback collection limit reached
cap.body: This fallback refresh needs one keyword lookup. Existing stored data remains available.

fallbackReasons.gsc_not_connected: Search Console is not connected for this workspace.
fallbackReasons.gsc_needs_reconnect: The Google connection needs to be reconnected.
fallbackReasons.gsc_revoked: Google access was revoked and must be reconnected.
fallbackReasons.gsc_property_unmatched: The selected Search Console property does not cover this site.

disclosure.rolling: Rolling {{days}} days with the documented Search Console reporting lag
disclosure.pointInTime: Point-in-time ranking snapshot; {{days}} days changes history and comparison context, not the headline snapshot metrics
disclosure.coverage: Coverage: {{accepted}} source rows accepted, {{dropped}} dropped; {{inventory}} inventory pages, {{measured}} measured, and {{unmeasured}} unmeasured.
disclosure.noReportingLag: This source has no Search Console reporting-lag claim.
disclosure.notSampled: The source did not report sampling.

metrics.qualifierObserved: Observed for the selected rolling window
metrics.qualifierEstimated: Estimated from the current ranking snapshot

filters.title: Find pages
filters.description: Search and filters are evaluated on the server and never collect new vendor data.
filters.searchPlaceholder: Title, path, URL, query, or keyword
filters.noneActive: No search or filters are active.

striking_distance.label: Striking distance
striking_distance.description: This page ranks close enough to improve and has meaningful search demand.

low_ctr.label: Low CTR
low_ctr.description: Observed impressions are strong, but the page earns fewer clicks than the rule threshold.

declining.label: Declining
declining.description: Position or observed clicks fell materially since the previous successful sync.

winning.label: Winning
winning.description: Position or observed clicks improved materially since the previous successful sync.

non_indexable_visibility.label: Visible but not crawl-indexable
non_indexable_visibility.description: The page has search performance while the latest RankMeFast crawl marks it non-indexable. This is not a Google index-status claim.

unmeasured.label: Unmeasured
unmeasured.description: The latest crawl found this indexable page, but the current performance source has no row for it.

empty.title: No pages to show
empty.filtered: No page matches the current search and filters. Reset them to return to the full stored inventory.
empty.gsc: Search Console returned no pages for this rolling window. Refresh stays with Search Console and does not switch sources.
empty.fallback: The stored ranking snapshot contains no ranking pages for this market. Observed metrics remain unavailable.
empty.none: No page snapshot has been stored. Connect Google or explicitly collect fallback data.

pagination.label: Pages results pagination
pagination.cursorReset: The stored result set changed, so pagination returned to the first page.

detail.title: Page detail
detail.errorTitle: Page detail could not be loaded
detail.notFound: That page is no longer in the current inventory. The list remains available.
detail.noOpportunities: No current opportunity rule applies to this page.
detail.truncated: The response is capped at 100 rows.
detail.associatedEmpty: No associated query or keyword rows are stored for this page.
detail.associatedCaption: Associated queries or keywords for this page
detail.trendDescription: {{count}} stored points, with at most 90 returned.
detail.trendEmpty: No comparable average-position history is stored yet.
